Links without title get empty title attribute when defaultTitle is true

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p><a href='https://example.com'>Link</a></p>", HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(default_title: true))
puts result.content.inspect
```
